security_audit.summary: All 12 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and code fences; the cited text does not perform Ruby or shell backtick execution. However, the topic reference exposes authenticated publishing commands despite read-only metadata. The skill also lacks instructions for isolating untrusted community content from agent instructions.

remediation.issue: The read-only skill documents topic creation and reply commands that can publish content through an authenticated account.
remediation.suggestion: Remove create and create-reply commands from this skill, or move them to a separate write-enabled skill requiring explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Community topic details and replies are external, user-generated text without an explicit prompt-injection boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Require the agent to treat retrieved content only as data, ignore embedded instructions, and never execute commands found in that content.

content.value_statement: Stock research requires checking news, filings, discussions, and market rules across separate sources. This skill organizes Longbridge content into focused, structured analysis.
actual_capabilities: Retrieves recent Longbridge news for listed stock symbols.
Lists company announcements and fetches available filing content.
Searches and summarizes community discussion topics.
Explains selected A-share, Hong Kong, and United States market rules.
Responds in English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese.
limitations: Live retrieval requires the Longbridge CLI or an available Longbridge MCP integration.
Coverage and freshness depend on the Longbridge data source.
Regulatory information can become outdated and should be checked against official sources.
Outputs provide general research information, not personalized investment advice.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Company Events
use_cases.description: Combine recent news and filings into a neutral summary of material company developments.

use_cases.title: Analyze SEC Disclosures
use_cases.description: Extract financial trends, risk changes, management commentary, and material events from a selected filing.

use_cases.title: Explain Trading Regulations
use_cases.description: Summarize settlement, price limits, margin, short-selling, or circuit-breaker rules for supported markets.

prompt_templates.title: Get Recent Stock News
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the latest Longbridge news for [SYMBOL]. Group related items and give a neutral key takeaway.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a concise news review

prompt_templates.title: Review Company Filings
prompt_templates.prompt: List recent filings for [SYMBOL]. Summarize the most material filing and cite its date and form type.

prompt_templates.title: Compare News and Discussion
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare recent news and community discussion for [SYMBOL]. Separate verified facts from sentiment and note limited coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate comparison of formal and informal sources

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an SEC Filing
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the latest [FORM TYPE] for [SYMBOL]. Compare key metrics, identify changed risks, assess liquidity, and separate facts from interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced filing analysis for an investment research workflow

output_examples.output: Recent coverage is grouped into earnings, strategy, regulation, and analyst opinion. The summary identifies dated facts and separates community sentiment from reported events.

output: Filing metadata with form, filing date, and reporting period.
Key revenue, earnings, cash-flow, margin, and liquidity changes.
Updated risks and management commentary, followed by a neutral interpretation.

output_examples.input: Explain the United States pattern day trader rule.
output_examples.output: A structured explanation covers the account threshold, day-trade definition, applicable window, consequences, and a reminder to verify current FINRA guidance.

best_practices: Provide an exchange-qualified symbol, such as AAPL.US or 700.HK.
Specify the desired date range, filing type, or research question.
Verify regulatory details and important decisions against current official sources.
anti_patterns: Do not treat community sentiment as verified company information.
Do not request personalized investment, legal, or tax advice.
Do not assume sparse or stale Longbridge coverage proves that no event occurred.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Public reading commands are documented as login-free. Some topic publishing commands shown in the source require authentication and should not be used automatically.

faq.question: Which markets does the skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers listed-stock content and selected regulations for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, and United States equities.

faq.question: Which SEC forms can it analyze?
faq.answer: The guidance covers 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements, Form 4, and selected ownership disclosures.

faq.question: Can it provide real-time market data?
faq.answer: The skill focuses on news, filings, topics, and regulatory explanations. Availability and timing depend on Longbridge tools and data coverage.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes research information and requires a reference-only disclaimer.

faq.question: What happens when Longbridge data is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill can use an available MCP integration. Some guidance also permits clearly labeled web search when news is empty or stale.
